affected_predicate.description: Successful SMS login is completed so checkout can proceed.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent entered the placeholder code 123456 despite stating it could not obtain the actual SMS verification code; the later login screen visibly reports that the verification code is incorrect.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 10, the target repeats the false completion premise that SMS login was already completed and performs another login-button click while the login form remains visible. The premise continues through the subsequent agreement-checkbox and login attempts, but is explicitly corrected when the screen shows a verification-code error after step 12. A new code is sent later, but no successful login is visibly reached.

summary: The reused false statement that SMS login was complete is visibly carried into a repeated login attempt, then corrected by the displayed verification-code error; successful login is not observed.
